sft_fields.prompt: Complete ChatML prompt (system prompt + patient turn), opening the assistant turn.
sft_fields.completion: Expected triage answer: level, justification, recommendation.
sft_fields.user_turn: The patient turn alone, useful for deduplication and audit.
sft_fields.lang: Language of the patient description (fr | en).
sft_fields.source: Origin of the example (clinical_vignette, mediqal, medquad, frenchmedmcqa, medmcqa).
sft_fields.confidence: Confidence of the label: high (clinical catalogue) | medium (rule applied to a corpus).
sft_fields.symptoms: Clinical signs present in the description.
sft_fields.medical_history: Patient history mentioned in the description.
sft_fields.vitals: Vital-sign reading, empty when triage happens without measurements.
sft_fields.presentation_id: Identifier of the catalogue presentation, empty for corpus cases.

dpo_fields.prompt: ChatML prompt identical to the supervised set's.
dpo_fields.chosen: Preferred answer: right level, format respected, safe course of action.
dpo_fields.rejected: Rejected answer, same format and comparable length.
dpo_fields.user_turn: The patient turn alone, useful for deduplication and audit.
dpo_fields.level: Reference triage level of the case.
dpo_fields.strategy: The defect introduced: undertriage | unsafe_recommendation | asserted_diagnosis | answered_in_english.

evaluation_fields.prompt: ChatML prompt identical to the supervised set's.
evaluation_fields.completion: Always empty: the expected answer is not given, only the level is.
evaluation_fields.user_turn: The patient turn alone, as it is submitted to the model.
evaluation_fields.level: Reference triage level, written by hand.
evaluation_fields.case_type: Nature of the difficulty: empty (direct presentation), falsely_reassuring, falsely_alarming, negation, discordant_vitals.
evaluation_fields.description: The patient description alone, without the framing prompt.
evaluation_fields.clinical_note: Clinical reason for the label, for auditability and error analysis.

triage_taxonomy.URGENCE_VITALE: Immediate care (sorts 1 and 2 of the FRENCH scale).
triage_taxonomy.URGENCE_MODEREE: Care within a few hours (sorts 3 and 4).

system_prompt:
Tu es l'assistant de triage médical du service des urgences. Tu aides le personnel soignant à évaluer le degré d'urgence d'un patient à partir de ses symptômes, de ses antécédents et de ses constantes vitales.

Tu réponds TOUJOURS en français et selon le format suivant :
Niveau de priorité : <URGENCE_VITALE | URGENCE_MODEREE | CONSULTATION_DIFFEREE>
Justification : <explication clinique courte et claire>
Recommandation : <conduite à tenir pour le patient et le personnel>

Règles de sécurité :
- En cas de doute ou de signe de gravité, surclasse le niveau d'urgence.
- Ne pose jamais de diagnostic définitif : tu fournis une aide à la décision.
- Rappelle de contacter le 15 (SAMU) devant tout signe vital engagé.

clinical_vignette.origin: Catalogue of clinical presentations written for this project (src/clinical_triage/data/clinical_catalogue.py)
clinical_vignette.role: Triage ground truth: the level comes from the presentation, not from the text.

mediqal.role: The only source corpus that describes patients. Base of the authentic French vignettes.

medquad.role: Symptom descriptions, labelled by the rule (medium confidence).

medmcqa.role: Added because the other source corpora hold no English-language clinical vignettes.

frenchmedmcqa.role: Pharmacy exam questions, none of which can be labelled for triage.

ultramedical_preference.role: External preference set, kept out of training: an independent measure of the alignment.

gdpr.principle: Minimisation: no real patient data. The vignettes are synthetic, and the public corpora are research sets with no identifying data.
gdpr.masking: Presidio (French and English spaCy), limited to genuinely identifying entities (PERSON, PHONE_NUMBER, EMAIL_ADDRESS, CREDIT_CARD, IBAN_CODE, IP_ADDRESS, URL, US_SSN, FR_NIR, FR_TELEPHONE, DATE_NAISSANCE, DATE_NAISSANCE_ISO).

entities_left_out.DATE_TIME: masks onset delays, which are a triage criterion
entities_left_out.LOCATION: masks the names of organs and of hospital departments
entities_left_out.NRP: masks the names of conditions and of molecules
entities_left_out.MEDICAL_LICENSE: fires on bibliographic references in the corpora
